# Machine changes

Declared API elements that changed between consecutive registered releases, extracted mechanically from the pinned upstream files: C/C++ headers, the in-tree Python and NodeJS bindings, the JSON schemas and the protocol version tables of documents 3.1 and 3.3. Each record compares a release with the previous registered release: `added` and `removed` elements, `modified` signatures (with the previous text) and `deprecated` markers. An `unclassified` record marks a changed header, binding or schema file whose declared elements did not change (comments or formatting changed, or a construct the parser does not read), or a file that could not be parsed. Prose documentation changes, including the prose of documents 3.1 and 3.3, appear only in each version's `Changed since` list.

Quotes are upstream text with whitespace collapsed, cut at 300 characters; a modified pair that would look identical after the cut starts with `…` just before the first difference. Quotes show what changed, not what it means at run time; read the pinned file before relying on a record.

- added schema-property `definitions.settingSection.label`: `{"$ref": "#/definitions/i18nString", "description": "用于在用户界面中展示，支持国际化。如果未设置，则显示 name 字段的值", "title": "显示名称"}`
